name: radare2
description: Advanced reverse engineering framework with comprehensive binary analysis and debugging tools

r2agent.description: Remote agent for radare2 allowing network-based reverse engineering sessions

r2pm.description: Package manager for radare2 plugins and extensions
r2pm.usage:
r2pm update
r2pm search keyword
r2pm install package_name
r2pm list
r2pm uninstall package_name

r2r.description: Test runner for radare2 regression testing and validation
r2r.usage:
r2r test_file.r2
r2r -j tests/
r2r -v tests/
r2r -i

rabin2.description: Binary analysis tool for extracting information from executables
rabin2.usage:
rabin2 -I binary.exe
rabin2 -i binary.exe
rabin2 -E binary.exe
rabin2 -S binary.exe
rabin2 -z binary.exe

radare2.description: Advanced reverse engineering framework with disassembler and debugger
radare2.usage:
radare2 binary.exe
r2 -A binary.exe
r2 -d program.exe
r2 -w binary.exe
r2 -B 0x1000 mem.dump

radiff2.description: Binary diffing tool for comparing executables and finding differences between versions
radiff2.usage:
radiff2 file1.exe file2.exe
radiff2 -g file1.exe file2.exe
radiff2 -A file1.exe file2.exe
radiff2 -C file1.exe file2.exe

rafind2.description: Advanced search tool for finding patterns, strings, and bytes in binary files
rafind2.usage:
rafind2 -s 'string' file.bin
rafind2 -x 4142434445 file.bin
rafind2 -e /regex/i file.bin
rafind2 -z file.bin

ragg2.description: Shellcode compiler and payload generator for exploit development
ragg2.usage:
ragg2 -a x86 -b 64 shellcode.r
ragg2 -F elf64 -o payload shellcode.r
ragg2 -P print_shellcode.r
ragg2 -L

rahash2.description: Cryptographic hash calculator supporting multiple algorithms for file integrity verification
rahash2.usage:
rahash2 file.exe
rahash2 -a md5 file.exe
rahash2 -a sha256 file.exe
rahash2 -c hash_to_verify file.exe
rahash2 -B 1024 file.exe

rapatch2.description: Binary patching tool for applying modifications and fixes to executable files
rapatch2.usage:
rapatch2 -p patch.r2 binary.exe
rapatch2 -w 0x1000 "41414141" binary.exe
rapatch2 -r 0x1000:10 binary.exe
rapatch2 -s old_bytes new_bytes binary.exe

rarun2.description: Process launcher and runtime environment controller for debugging and analysis
rarun2.usage:
rarun2 program=target.exe
rarun2 program=target.exe arg1=value
rarun2 stdin=input.txt program=target.exe
rarun2 timeout=30 program=target.exe

rasign2.description: Function signature generator and matcher for binary analysis and library identification
rasign2.usage:
rasign2 -g signature.sig binary.exe
rasign2 -a signature.sig target.exe
rasign2 -f function_name binary.exe
rasign2 -r

rasm2.description: Multi-architecture assembler and disassembler supporting numerous CPU architectures
rasm2.usage:
rasm2 -a x86 -b 64 'mov rax, rbx'
rasm2 -a arm -d '0x12345678'
rasm2 -L
rasm2 -f input.asm

ravc2.description: Version control system for radare2 projects and analysis session management
ravc2.usage:
ravc2 init project_name
ravc2 save checkpoint1
ravc2 load checkpoint1
ravc2 diff checkpoint1 checkpoint2
ravc2 log

rax2.description: Number base converter and mathematical calculator for various numeric formats
rax2.usage:
rax2 0x1000
rax2 -b 4096
rax2 -k 10+20*3
rax2 -s hello
rax2 -S 48656c6c6f
